title: Decoding News Bias: Multi Bias Detection in News Articles

bias_targets.methodology: Multi-label text classification of news articles using fine-tuned transformer models (e.g., BERT, RoBERTa) evaluated against a dataset automatically annotated by an LLM (GPT-4o mini) using instruction-based prompting.
